{{Top|leg}}
A '''seismic missile''' was a type of [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic]] [[Missile/Legends|missile]] designed for [[Space warfare/Legends|space warfare]]. It usually did massive damage to armor but very little damage to [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>
{{Weapon-stub}}
